PlayerSave.title: PlayerSave
PlayerSave.description: Cloud-synced campaign progress, inventory, and settings for a signed-in Vice Bay player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

displayName.description: Player display name shown in profile HUD.

robbedStores.description: Store IDs already robbed in this save.

seenIntro.description: Whether the opening 2-minute cutscene has been watched.

position.description: Latest player world coordinates (x, y, z).

inventory.description: Player weapon, ammo, armor, and sprint tier inventory.

heat.description: Player wanted stars, pursuit phase, and last known position.

rpgStats.description: San Andreas RPG character stats (respect, staminaSkill, muscle, fat, hunger, weaponSkill, drivingSkill).

weaponArsenal.description: Equipped weapon ID, per-weapon attachments, and reserve ammo by weapon category.

capturedTurfs.description: District turf zone IDs captured by Vice Crew.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when cloud save was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when cloud save was last updated.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public arcade contract leaderboard entry tied to a verified Firebase Auth user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

contractsCompleted.description: Total completed contracts recorded for this player.

bestDurationMs.description: Fastest contract completion duration in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated.

/players/{userId}.description: Private cloud campaign save per authenticated Firebase user.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public top-scores leaderboard entries (document ID equals the player's Firebase Auth UID).
